LESSON: READING 10.2.1 NOTE MAKING

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.2: Reading 10.2.1 Note Making

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading 10.2.1 Note Making. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: what situations could notes be made?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify main points or ideas in an argumentative passage
2. value the importance of note making while reading for pleasure or academic purposes

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: READING 10.2.1 NOTE MAKING
This lesson teaches Reading 10.2.1 Note Making for Grade 9 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify main points or ideas in an argumentative passage
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. value the importance of note making while reading for pleasure or academic purposes
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Reading 10.2.1 Note Making using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Reading 10.2.1 Note Making above.
2. Explain Reading 10.2.1 Note Making to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Reading 10.2.1 Note Making.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 10.2.1 Note Making with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 10.2.1 Note Making important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. what situations could notes be made?
2. Why is it important to make notes?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify main points or ideas in an argumentative passage
2. value the importance of note making while reading for pleasure or academic purposes

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
